% Files of the document that give a .4ht's name in \ProvidesFile, read
% with the primitive \input in each of its forms, with hyperref. Each read
% copies the macro the file defines, so that the page shows each file's
% text only if that read found the file. As in the PDF, each file's text
% is in the page.
% - test-priminput/glossary.tex names itself like glossary.4ht. It is
%   read with its extension, with the name ended by \relax, with a % at
%   the end of the line, so that TeX reads the name on to the next line,
%   and with LaTeX's name of the primitive, \@@input.
% - test-priminput/my glossary.tex has a space in its name, read with a
%   quoted name.
% - test-priminput/above.tex is read by a relative path that leaves the
%   document's folder with ".." and comes back to it. (The file is in
%   test/fixtures, whose files the build's stamp hashes, so that an edit
%   to it builds the page again.)
% - test-priminput/defs.tex, in a subfolder, and provdefs.ltx, beside the
%   document, give the name of another file, glossary.tex.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\makeatletter
\input test-priminput/glossary.tex
\let\primext\primglossary \let\primglossary\relax
\input test-priminput/glossary\relax
\let\primrelax\primglossary \let\primglossary\relax
\input test-priminput/glossary%
\let\primcomment\primglossary \let\primglossary\relax
\@@input test-priminput/glossary
\let\primalias\primglossary
\input "test-priminput/my glossary"
\input ../fixtures/test-priminput/above
\input test-priminput/defs
\input provdefs.ltx
\makeatother
\begin{document}
Extension: \primext\par
Relax: \primrelax\par
Comment: \primcomment\par
Alias: \primalias\par
Quoted: \primquoted\par
Above: \primabove\par
Definitions: \primdefs\par
Root: \provdefs
\end{document}
